requirement.title: The analyzer does not work if SuppressSourceGeneration = true
requirement.text:
#### Bug description

The analyzer does not work if SuppressSourceGeneration = true. This has happened since version 3.1.1. It still worked in 3.1.0.

story: Stops the type collector from crashing on duplicate or mixed keys, which is presumably why the analyzer died for suppressed types. Also adds README text and runtime round-trip tests.

decisions.title: Dependency change in Directory.Packages.props
decisions.oneliner: Dependency and toolchain versions decide which users can build and run the package.
decisions.question: Accept this dependency or toolchain change?
decisions.routed_by: policy rule 'dependency': the reviewer may not decide this

decisions.title: Credential change in SuppressSourceGenerationAnalyzerTests.cs
decisions.oneliner: A credential in source is exposed to everyone who can read the repository, and stays in its history.
decisions.question: Remove the credential and rotate it?
decisions.routed_by: policy rule 'secret': the reviewer may not decide this

decisions.title: Inverted guard drops string-keyed fields
decisions.oneliner: Second loop adds only when the key already exists: every string-keyed member is dropped, and a duplicate key still throws.
decisions.would_be_wrong_if: This second loop is unreachable for string-keyed members. That is unlikely, since it mirrors the first loop.
decisions.question: Should this be `!stringMembers.ContainsKey`, as in the other three places?

decisions.title: Duplicate keys now silently dropped
decisions.oneliner: The first member with a key wins and later ones are ignored. Nothing shows that the duplicate-key diagnostic (MsgPack005) still fires before this point.
decisions.would_be_wrong_if: Code outside the diff already reports duplicate keys before this point.
decisions.question: Is a duplicate-key diagnostic still reported somewhere for both normal and suppressed types?

decisions.title: README claims behaviour the diff doesn't show
decisions.oneliner: Lists five diagnostics that are enforced and three that are skipped for suppressed types. Nothing in the diff implements or verifies that split.
quote: The analyzer still validates these types, because they are serialized at run time and must still have a valid contract:

The analyzer does not report the partial-class requirement ([MsgPack011](doc/analyzers/MsgPack011.md)) or the AOT-only checks ([MsgPack016](doc/analyzers/MsgPack016.md) and [MsgPack017](doc/analyzers/MsgPack017.md)) for these types, because they only apply when a formatter is generated.
decisions.would_be_wrong_if: Code outside the diff already filters diagnostics this way for suppressed types.
decisions.question: Do you want this README section in a bug fix, given the behaviour it describes isn't verified?

handled.title: New `continue` skips the rest of the member's handling
handled.oneliner: Members with mixed key kinds now skip formatter-attribute handling and later checks, which may hide other diagnostics or change generated output.
quote: continue; // The key kind does not match the other members; the diagnostic is reported, so skip this member.
handled.would_be_wrong_if: Nothing after this point in the loop matters once MsgPack005 is reported.
handled.routed_by: low impact or no decision needed

handled.title: Tests don't cover the analyzer at all
handled.oneliner: The new tests only check runtime round-trip and that no formatter is generated. That worked before the change, so they don't show the bug is fixed.
handled.would_be_wrong_if: The policy-gated analyzer test file covers these cases, including string keys on fields.
handled.routed_by: low impact or no decision needed

not_checked: The test suite was not run (no .NET SDK on the review host).
Whether the 3.1.1 regression was really a Dictionary.Add exception, or the analyzer skipping suppressed types altogether.
Where the code decides whether SuppressSourceGeneration types are analyzed, and whether MsgPack011/016/017 are skipped for them.
Whether the policy-gated analyzer tests exercise string-keyed fields and duplicate keys.
